findings.jobs: Four notification families total 7,437 posts; each contains multiple post codes. Post codes, vacancies, locations and form grouping need review before defining distinct application cycles.
findings.internationalApplicants: Original four notices and reviewed amendments do not state general nationality permission. Do not infer a positive foreign-citizen match from fee rules or non-local reservation wording. Check Telangana service rules and authority before any eligibility claim.
findings.language: SI Civil/equivalent final written exam has qualifying English and Telugu-or-Urdu papers at Matriculation standard. PC Civil/equivalent papers are English-Telugu or English-Urdu; English questions in syllabus remain English. These are test-medium/subject conditions, not a universal CEFR level. Other two families need post-specific review.
findings.venues: 17 September press note gives tentative SI preliminary test 29 November and PC preliminary test 20 December; exact centres are not established by these notices. No map pins assigned.
